desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.

desc: A tribute to the legendary music composer and singer, the late Bappi Lahiri, where top Tollywood and Bollywood artistes sing his popular compositions.

desc: Two best friends, Mangal and Deep, embark on a journey to the big city to fulfil their musical dreams. In his quest to see Deep succeed, Mangal risks everything, including his own finances.

desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Bhoy
desc: Rupsha and her husband move into their new rented house, but the house is haunted by the spirit of its previous tenant. Rupsha gets possessed by the demonic spirit seeking revenge.
